title: FM27 Skins — Football Manager 27 Skin Index & Install
description: FM27 skins: none exist before the 10 November launch. The install path, why FM26 skins have to be rebuilt, and which FM26 skins were still shipping fixes in October 2026.
meta: Football Manager 27 skins — install path, cache rules, and what has to be rebuilt for the new interface.
body:
There are no FM27 skins yet, and that is not a gap in this page — it is how skins work. A skin replaces interface panels, so it has to be built against the interface that actually ships. FM27 arrives on 10 November 2026, and Sports Interactive's feature posts specifically call out a clearer interface and smarter navigation. Panels that moved will break layouts that were tuned for FM26.

What can be done now: know the install path, know why a port is needed, and know which FM26 skins are still being maintained, because those authors are the ones most likely to port.

Why FM26 skins will not simply carry over

An FM skin is a set of replacement panels and styles for the game's own interface. When the interface changes, the panel files no longer match, and the skin either fails to load or loads with empty or overlapping sections. The version strings tell you how tightly this is coupled: FM26 skins in wide use are still numbered against game builds — ASF Skin for FM26 sits at v26.3.2, Vanta Black Electric shipped as v1.0 for FM26, and skogr's FM26 skin was still receiving bug-fix updates in late October 2026.

A skin author therefore has two jobs after launch: rebuild the panels against the new layout, and keep rebuilding after each game patch.

Where skins and graphics go

FM keeps one user-data tree under Documents, created the first time the game launches. FM26 used:

  • Windows: Documents\Sports Interactive\Football Manager 2026
  • macOS: ~/Documents/Sports Interactive/Football Manager 2026

Inside that folder, content is split by type — saves, tactics, skins, graphics, cache and editor files each in their own subfolder. FM27 will create its own version-named folder in the same tree on first launch; check the folder name before you paste anything into it, because a pack dropped one directory too high is the most common "the skin does not show" cause.

Stale cache is the second most common cause. If a skin or graphics pack installs but does not appear, clear the cache folder and reload the skin with caching off before you assume the download is broken.

What a skin changes, and what it cannot

  • Changes: panel layout, colours and typography, which attributes and columns you see where, and how much of the match-day interface is on one screen.
  • Does not change: player data, the match engine, or what your scouts report. A skin is a window, not a database edit.
  • Safe mid-save: switching skins does not require a new save, because nothing in the save file depends on the interface.

Checks before you install any FM27 skin

  • Version string vs game version. A skin numbered for a previous major version will not match FM27 panels.
  • Last update date. An FM26 skin last touched in 2025 is not a candidate for a port.
  • Patch notes. Good skin threads say which game patch they were rebuilt against. If the thread does not, treat it as untested.
  • Screenshots of the panels you actually use — squad view, player profile, match day. A home-screen screenshot proves nothing.

The FM27 skin watchlist

Skins that were still being maintained for FM26 in September and October 2026 are the realistic port candidates. At the time of writing, that group includes skogr (bug-fix update dated 21 October 2026), Vanta Black Electric (v1.0, September 2026) and ASF Skin (v26.3.2), all listed on FM Scout. This page will add each FM27 port with its version string and the date it was checked — and nothing before a port actually exists.

Dates that matter for FM27 skins

  • 29 October 2026 — Launch Preview opens; the interface is visible for the first time, so authors can start measuring what moved.
  • 10 November 2026 — launch build. Ports can only be built against this or a later patch.
  • Each FM27 patch — any patch that touches interface panels forces another skin rebuild. This is why dated version strings matter more than star ratings on a download page.

What this page will not do

No links to files that have not been checked against an FM27 build. No FM26 skin presented as an FM27 skin with a renamed title. No "best skin" ranking before at least two skins exist to compare.
